_README: Points of interest. EMPTY on purpose — POIs are placed in the editor now:
name a mesh Home_ or Work_ and it becomes one where it stands.
The 136 that used to live here were a test rig: four stacked on each
delivery point, home and work at the IDENTICAL coordinates. That gave every
resident a zero-length commute, which is a poor thing to ask an AI to do and
a candidate for the memory growth seen on 2026-09-01. They also inflated
population from nowhere, making the real placement impossible to read.
Entries here still work if a POI ever needs placing without an editor pass.
